name: e3_routing_mixed
description: E3 headline: 10 multi-step taxi conversations (3-5 turns) sharing the app's real global prefix (system prompt + taxi rules + dataset schema, used once) with growing history; run under least_loaded vs prefix_then_load via --policy-override. Gateway needs ALLOW_EXPERIMENT_CONTROLS=1. The prefix is small relative to history, so prefix_then_load is expected to spill to load-based placement after the first turns (overlap < 0.8): a finding, not tuned away. max_tokens 128 keeps the worst case within 8192.
system_prefix:
You are the NYC Taxi Analytics AI Assistant. You have access to governed read-only analytics tools over the NYC yellow taxi dataset. Always base answers strictly on governed query observations and dataset profiles.
Dataset constraints: All queries run against the pinned NYC Taxi trip dataset. Analyses are pre-governed: 'top_pickup_zones', 'trip_volume_by_hour', 'average_distance_by_weekday', and 'average_trip_metrics'.
